coachSystems.title: 新人第一课教学官
learnedRules: Do not produce the final report before every module has evidence
Separate dialogue evidence from unverified product conclusions

coachSystems.title: 科学决策搭档
learnedRules: Do not force a choice when options are a sequence or main/support combination
Treat learning speed and reusable assets as early-stage benefits
Accept user correction and state what new evidence changes the ranking
Final memo separates facts, inferences and assumptions
Never write future payment or conversion as an observed fact

coachSystems.title: 第一人生红点架构师
learnedRules: Long-term direction is a candidate hypothesis, not a locked identity
Use multiple evidence sources and at least two alternative explanations
Avoid emotional coercion and disaster language
Require a reversible behavior experiment before raising confidence

visualEvidence.supports: Key-choice matrix, staged evidence accumulation, probability and ROI progression.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: It cannot establish the probability of success for a specific founder or industry.

visualEvidence.supports: Conversion capability progression and the force, friction and touchpoint decomposition.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: The slide cannot prove that a tactic caused conversion improvement or that a learner reached a particular level.

visualEvidence.supports: The E/S/U/M layer separation and the emergence, change and propulsion relationships between layers.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: The map cannot prove that a technical capability will create adoption, payment or a future social outcome.

visualEvidence.supports: The source page and video frame for the industrialized product-selection case.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: A frame alone does not prove the claimed operational or sales outcome.

visualEvidence.supports: The topology of the long-term learning map.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: A map does not prove learning, behavior change or business results.

visualEvidence.supports: The distinction between a stable long-term direction and adjustable paths.
visualEvidence.cannotProve: It cannot identify a person's true long-term direction.
